stylesheet did not load — script did not run

The paragraph below was not in the HTML. It was computed by a script and written into the document while the page was still being parsed.

The script that wrote it lives in hello-js.js next to this file — an external <script src>, fetched and executed mid-parse, which is why its output lands here rather than at the end of the page. Open the console output (monkey: WINDOW CONSOLE_LOG) to see the two log lines it emits.
